description: This file declares the MediaKeysClient class, which implements the IMediaKeysClient interface for handling media key-related IPC events in the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for license requests, renewals, and key status changes, and maintains internal handles and IPC client references.

classes.name: MediaKeysClient
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysClient interface to handle media key events via IPC in the Rialto server.

methods.name: MediaKeysClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media keys handle and IPC client reference.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events with session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events with session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles key status change events with session ID and key statuses.
